description: SSE frames captured from a real server turn (Firefox decoded-body cache), in the order the browser received them. This is the reproduction for the consent prompt that was silently dropped: the prompt frame reached the client BEFORE the tool.start frame that creates the tool call it attaches to.
source: local chat turn 'try search about cafe' -> browser_interact on tabId 5
observedOutcome: The prompt was dropped, so the user saw a plain 'Browser Interact ... Running' tool card with no way to answer, and the tool failed 5 minutes later with BROWSER_CONSENT_TIMEOUT.
